description: This file contains utility functions for managing nodes and edges in a flow-based UI, including ID generation, node initialization, connection validation, data export, and UI element show/hide logic.

methods.name: getUniqueNodeId
methods.description: Generates a unique node ID based on node data and existing nodes.

methods.name: getUniqueNodeLabel
methods.description: Creates a unique label for a node, appending a suffix if necessary.

methods.name: initializeDefaultNodeData
methods.description: Initializes default input values for a list of node parameters.

methods.name: initNode
methods.description: Initializes a node's data, including inputs, outputs, anchors, and IDs.

methods.name: updateOutdatedNodeData
methods.description: Updates node data to match the latest structure, preserving existing configurations.

methods.name: updateOutdatedNodeEdge
methods.description: Removes edges that are no longer valid after node updates.

methods.name: isValidConnection
methods.description: Checks if a connection between nodes is valid based on handle types.

methods.name: isValidConnectionAgentflowV2
methods.description: Checks if a connection in Agent Flow V2 is valid, preventing cycles and self-connections.

methods.name: convertDateStringToDateObject
methods.description: Converts a date string into a JavaScript Date object using moment.js.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Extracts filename from a base64 encoded file string.

methods.name: getFolderName
methods.description: Extracts folder names from an array of base64 encoded file strings.

methods.name: generateExportFlowData
methods.description: Exports flow data, removing sensitive info and resetting node selection.

methods.name: getAvailableNodesForVariable
methods.description: Finds parent nodes related to a target node for variable resolution.

methods.name: getUpsertDetails
methods.description: Identifies vector store nodes and related documents for upsert operations.

methods.name: rearrangeToolsOrdering
methods.description: Reorders tool list to prioritize requestsGet and requestsPost.

methods.name: throttle
methods.description: Creates a throttled version of a function to limit call rate.

methods.name: generateRandomGradient
methods.description: Generates a random CSS linear gradient string.

methods.name: getInputVariables
methods.description: Extracts variable names enclosed in curly braces from a string.

methods.name: removeDuplicateURL
methods.description: Removes duplicate URLs from source documents in a message.

methods.name: isValidURL
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid URL.

methods.name: formatDataGridRows
methods.description: Parses and formats data grid rows, assigning IDs.

methods.name: setLocalStorageChatflow
methods.description: Stores chat flow data in local storage.

methods.name: getLocalStorageChatflow
methods.description: Retrieves chat flow data from local storage.

methods.name: removeLocalStorageChatHistory
methods.description: Removes or preserves chat history in local storage.

methods.name: unshiftFiles
methods.description: Moves 'files' config to the front of config array.

methods.name: getConfigExamplesForJS
methods.description: Generates example code snippets for JS based on config data.

methods.name: getConfigExamplesForPython
methods.description: Generates example code snippets for Python based on config data.

methods.name: getConfigExamplesForCurl
methods.description: Generates example curl commands based on config data.

methods.name: getOS
methods.description: Detects the client's operating system.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Converts a byte count into a human-readable string.

methods.name: kFormatter
methods.description: Formats a number into a shortened string with suffixes (k, M, G, etc.).

methods.name: redirectWhenUnauthorized
methods.description: Redirects the browser based on error type.

methods.name: truncateString
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum length with ellipsis.

methods.name: getCustomConditionOutputs
methods.description: Parses condition code to generate output options and edges to remove.

methods.name: showHideInputs
methods.description: Controls visibility of input parameters based on conditions.

methods.name: showHideInputParams
methods.description: Controls visibility of input parameters array.

methods.name: showHideInputAnchors
methods.description: Controls visibility of input anchors array.
